recipes.name: PAN CON TOMATE & THAI CRAB CAKES
ingredients: 1 1/2 small Thai Chili (or 1/2 half Serrano pepper), seeded removed + finely chopped
2 garlic cloves, finely minced or crushed
8 oz lump crab meat, picked through (cartilage and shells fragments discarded)
1 Thai chili (or 1/2 half Serrano pepper), seeds removed + thinly sliced
1 loaf ciabatta bread (or another thick crust loaf of bread)
instructions: For the Crab Cakes Dipping Sauce

Combine chopped chilis, garlic, ginger, and lemongrass in a small bowl. - 1 ½ small Thai Chili (or 1/2 half Serrano pepper) seeded removed + finely chopped - 2 garlic cloves finely minced or crushed - 1 tbsp ginger grated - 1 tsp lemongrass grated
In a small pot, combine the sugar and water. Stir consistently over medium-low heat until the sugar is dissolved. - ⅓ cup sugar - 2 tbsp water
Cook for an additional 30 seconds until the syrup just begins to simmer.
Add the chili mixture and cook for another 30 seconds to 1 minute, or until the sauce is fragrant and thickened further.
Turn off the heat and add the rice vinegar, lime juice, and fish sauce. - 3 tbsp rice vinegar - 1 ½ tbsp lime juice - 2 tsp fish sauce
Allow the sauce to cool to room temperature before serving.
Optionally, garnish the sauce with cilantro. - 1 tbsp. cilantro finely chopped, optional
For the Crab Cakes

Combine the crab meat, chili, scallions, ginger, cilantro, egg, lime juice and zest, fish sauce, salt, and pepper in a bowl. Gently fold to combine with your hands or a spatula. - 8 oz lump crab meat picked through (cartilage and shells fragments discarded) - 1 Thai chili (or 1/2 half Serrano pepper) seeds removed + thinly sliced - 2 scallions (greens only) finely sliced - 1 tbsp ginger grated - 1 tbsp cilantro - 1 large egg beaten - 1 tbsp lime juice - 1 tsp lime zest - 1 tsp fish sauce - 1 tsp kosher salt - 1 tsp freshly ground black pepper
Add breadcrumbs to bring the mixture together. - ¼ cup panko breadcrumbs
Gently, shape the mixture into 4 even-sized patties.
Add the remaining breadcrumbs to a shallow bowl or plate. - ¾ cup panko breadcrumbs
Lightly coat the crab cakes in the breadcrumbs.
Heat half the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. - 1 tbsp vegetable oil
Reduce heat to medium-low and add two crab cakes. Cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes on each side.
Add more oil and repeat the process with the remaining crab cakes. - 1 tbsp vegetable oil
Serve with the dipping sauce.
For the Pan Con Tomate
Cut the tomatoes in half and grate them using the largest side of a box grater. - 2 large tomatoes (heirloom if possible)
Add the grated tomatoes to a bowl and add salt. Let sit while you prepare the bread. - 1 tsp kosher salt
Slice the ciabatta loaf in half lengthwise and then cut each half into 2-inch strips. - 1 loaf ciabatta bread (or another thick crust loaf of bread)
Generously brush the bread slices with olive oil and place cut-side up on a rimmed baking sheet. - 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
Place the baking sheet in the oven and broil for 2-4 minutes or until the slices have toasted.
Rub the slices with the cut sides of the garlic cloves. - 3 large garlic cloves halved
Top the slices with the tomato mixture.
Season with flakey salt and a generous drizzle of olive oil. - as needed flaky salt - extra virgin olive oil
